label: First total holder unheld in its operative act, if held total holders are totally held (inference)
rule: At the relative first total holder, the bridge turns being held into being totally held
meaning: New conditional derivation, a single application of the bridge at the relative first total holder. A total holder f not totally held in r is not MOTION_3 held in r, since by the bridge being held there would make it totally held. The bridge carries the load; on the physical-holder reading a beam carried by two walls is an ordinary statics case against it (under the C* support bundle that case does not apply and the bridge is untested), and Control part 2 shows the total-holding regress does not give the conclusion without it. Both premises stay OPEN. No premise is established.
